quote: Our main motivation for creating the ParaCrawl corpus is to improve the quality of machine translation systems.

We show that the obtained parallel corpora improve state-of-the-art results on common benchmarks, such as the WMT Shared Task on News Translation... We trained neural machine translation models where we added the corpus to existing data sets for language pairs ... BLEU scores ...

Parallel corpora are essential for building highquality machine translation systems and have found uses in many other natural language applications, such as learning paraphrases or cross-lingual projection of language tools.
datasets: WMT Shared Task on News Translation
outputs: parallel sentence pairs; machine-translated sentences used for training and evaluation
